Hi Nick, Can you tell me a bit about what Kindvoice is?

Of course! Kind Voice is a subverse dedicated to giving people exactly that. A kind voice to people in need of one. Whether you suffer from depression, anxiety, or just want a reason to rant to someone, a kind voice will be here for you if you need one.

If you need a kind voice, create a new post using [L] (for looking) your name, age, gender, times you're available to speak to, and a small snippet about why you're here. If you're looking to BE a kind voice, create a new post with [O] (for offering) your name, age, gender, and a small snippet about how you're here to help.

For example, I'm looking for a kind voice, so my post would look like:

[L] [22] [M] Nick - Been going through a rough patch of depression. Could use a kind voice.

At which point, a kind voice OFFERING help would PM you. Or, you're free to message someone that has created a post offering help.

In the event of trolls looking to cause harm to people, a message to me of their username and a screenshot of the offending conversation will get them a warning (for unhelpful comments) to a full on ban for maliciousness.
